questions.question: How many days of sick leave do I get a year?
questions.answer: Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave a year. [1]

questions.question: How much home leave do I earn?
questions.answer: Employees earn one day of home leave for every 20 days worked. [1]

questions.question: How long is paternity leave?
questions.answer: Female employees get 98 days of maternity leave, of which 60 days are fully paid. [1] Male employees get 15 days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 30 days of the birth. [1]

questions.question: How many days of maternity leave are paid?
questions.answer: Female employees get 98 days of maternity leave, of which 60 days are fully paid. [1] Male employees get 15 days of paid paternity leave, to be taken within 30 days of the birth. [1]

questions.question: What allowance do I get for working during Dashain?
questions.answer: Site staff who work during Dashain or Tihar because the plant must run get a substitute day off and a festival duty allowance of Rs 1,500 per day worked. [1]

questions.question: How many days before should I apply for leave?
questions.answer: Apply in the HR portal at least 7 days before planned leave. [1] Site staff must also confirm shift cover with the shift in-charge before applying. [1]

questions.question: How many days of mourning leave for the death of a parent?
questions.answer: Employees get 13 days of paid mourning leave (kriya bida) on the death of a parent or parent-in-law. [1]

questions.question: What is the daily allowance in the Kathmandu valley?
questions.answer: Where you travel: Kathmandu valley (for site staff); Daily allowance: Rs 2,500 per night. [1]

questions.question: When does the staff jeep leave for Gongar?
questions.answer: The company runs a staff jeep between Baluwatar and Gongar every Sunday and Thursday, leaving Baluwatar at 6:00. [1]

questions.question: What is the deadline to submit a travel claim?
questions.answer: Submit travel claims within 15 days of returning, with receipts, in the finance portal. [1]

questions.question: What is the hotel limit per night?
questions.answer: Hotels outside the site camp are booked by Admin and paid directly by the company, up to Rs 4,500 per night. [1]

questions.question: Who do I tell if I clicked a phishing link?
questions.answer: If you clicked a link or entered your password, call the IT desk on extension 210 immediately, day or night. [1]

questions.question: How long must my password be?
questions.answer: Passwords must be at least 12 characters and are changed every 180 days. [1]

questions.question: Who approves VPN access to SCADA?
questions.answer: Use the company VPN to reach the HR portal, finance portal and SCADA historian from outside the office. [1] VPN access for SCADA is given only to engineering staff and needs approval from the Head of Engineering and Operations. [1]

questions.question: What PPE do I need at the powerhouse?
questions.answer: Ear protection is required inside the powerhouse. [1]

questions.question: Who signs the tunnel entry permit?
questions.answer: No one enters the headrace tunnel without a written tunnel entry permit signed by the Plant Manager. [1]

questions.question: What is the emergency phone number at site?
questions.answer: Emergency phone at site: extension 100. [1]

questions.question: Where is the nearest hospital to the site?
questions.answer: The nearest hospital is Charikot Primary Health Centre, about two hours by road. [1]

questions.question: How big is the Kanchan Khola plant?
questions.answer: The company owns and operates the Kanchan Khola Hydroelectric Project, a 24 MW run-of-river plant in Dolakha district, Bagmati Province. [1]

questions.question: Who is the Chief Financial Officer?
questions.answer: Chief Financial Officer: Rajendra Adhikari. [1]

questions.question: How many staff does the company have?
questions.answer: The company has 86 staff: 22 at the head office and 64 at site. [1] Site staff work in three shifts because the powerhouse is staffed 24 hours a day. [1] The company runs a staff jeep between Baluwatar and Gongar every Sunday and Thursday, leaving Baluwatar at 6:00. [2]

questions.question: What is the dry season tariff in FY 2082/83?
questions.answer: In FY 2082/83 the plant is in its third escalation year, so the tariff is Rs 9.16 per kWh in the dry season and Rs 5.23 per kWh in the wet season. [1]

questions.question: What is the wet season base tariff?
questions.answer: Season: Wet season; Months: Baisakh to Mangsir (mid-April to mid-December); Base tariff: Rs 4.80 per kWh. [1] In FY 2082/83 the plant is in its third escalation year, so the tariff is Rs 9.16 per kWh in the dry season and Rs 5.23 per kWh in the wet season. [1]

questions.question: How long do we have to file a deemed energy claim?
questions.answer: Deemed energy claims must be filed with NEA within 30 days of the outage with SCADA records. [1] If the deemed energy claim is accepted, Rs 1.6 crore will be added. [2]

questions.question: What is the contract energy in the PPA?
questions.answer: The PPA sets a contract energy of 138.6 GWh a year, of which 31.2 GWh is dry-season energy. [1]

questions.question: What is the expected revenue this fiscal year?
questions.answer: Expected generation is 141 GWh, of which 30 GWh in the dry season. [1] Expected revenue from energy sales is Rs 87.4 crore. [1]

questions.question: What is the insurance budget?
questions.answer: Item: Insurance; Budget: Rs 1.6 crore. [1]

questions.question: How much loan principal do we repay this year?
questions.answer: The project loan from the bank consortium led by a commercial bank has Rs 182 crore outstanding at the start of the year. [1] Principal repayment this year is Rs 21 crore and interest is about Rs 17.5 crore, at the consortium's base rate plus 2%. [1]

questions.question: How much did the plant generate in Q1?
questions.answer: The plant generated 49.8 GWh in Q1, against a plan of 54.0 GWh. [1]

questions.question: How much cash was in the bank at the end of Ashwin?
questions.answer: Cash in the bank at the end of Ashwin was Rs 14.3 crore. [1]

questions.question: Who approves a purchase between Rs 50,001 and Rs 5 lakh?
questions.answer: Amount (per purchase): Rs 50,001 to Rs 5 lakh; Who approves: Head of department and CFO. [1] Amount (per purchase): Rs 5 lakh to Rs 50 lakh; Who approves: CFO and CEO. [1]

questions.question: What TDS rate applies to supplier payments for goods?
questions.answer: Finance deducts TDS at 1.5% on supplier payments for goods and 15% on service fees paid to individuals, as required by the Income Tax Act. [1]

questions.question: When do we need a sealed tender?
questions.answer: Purchases above Rs 20 lakh need a sealed tender published in a national daily, as required by the company's procurement rules. [1]

questions.question: What should we do when sediment at the intake is above 7,000 ppm?
questions.answer: Sediment at intake: Above 7,000 ppm; Action: Shut down all units and close the intake gate. [1]

questions.question: When can we restart after a sediment shutdown?
questions.answer: Restart only after sediment stays below 4,000 ppm for 2 hours. [1]

questions.question: How long do units stay at speed-no-load after a line trip?
questions.answer: If the 132 kV line trips, the units go to no-load automatically. [1] Inform the NEA load dispatch centre and keep the units at speed-no-load for up to 30 minutes. [1]

questions.question: When is the annual overhaul done?
questions.answer: The annual overhaul is done in the dry season, from 10 to 30 Chaitra, when river flow is lowest and only one unit can run anyway. [1]

questions.question: How often do we take a transformer oil sample?
questions.answer: Check: Transformer oil sample; How often: Every 6 months. [1]

questions.question: Which towers were damaged in the Bhadra line outage?
questions.answer: At 02:40 on 3 Bhadra 2082, a landslide near Kharidhunga damaged two towers (tower 27 and tower 28) of the 132 kV line between Gongar and Singati. [1]

questions.question: When was the 132 kV line restored after the landslide?
questions.answer: A temporary bypass line was built and the line was restored at 18:10 on 9 Bhadra. [1] At 02:40 on 3 Bhadra 2082, a landslide near Kharidhunga damaged two towers (tower 27 and tower 28) of the 132 kV line between Gongar and Singati. [2] After 30 minutes without the line, the shift in-charge stopped all units. [2]

questions.question: How long does the SCADA historian keep data?
questions.answer: A historian keeps one-minute averages for 10 years. [1] Engineering staff reach the historian over the company VPN. [1] Export data with the historian's report tool; do not copy the database. [1]

questions.question: What is the salary band for grade G3?
questions.answer: Grade: G3; Typical roles: Junior engineer, accountant, HR officer; Monthly gross salary: Rs 55,000 to Rs 80,000. [1]

questions.question: How much does the company contribute to the Social Security Fund?
questions.answer: Social Security Fund: the company contributes 20% of basic salary and the employee 11%. [1]

questions.question: What increment does a rating of 4 get?
questions.answer: Rating: 4; Meaning: Exceeds expectations; Increment on basic salary: 7%. [1] Rating: 3; Meaning: Meets expectations; Increment on basic salary: 4%. [1]

questions.question: When are manager reviews due?
questions.answer: Manager reviews due: 30 Kartik 2082. [1]

questions.question: How many operators are we hiring?
questions.answer: Position: Operator; Grade: G2; Number: 3; Location: Gongar; Status: Advertised in Ashwin. [1] Operator candidates must hold at least a diploma in electrical or mechanical engineering. [1]

questions.question: What is the indicative price for the Upper Kanchan Khola stake?
questions.answer: Management presented a proposal to buy a 70% stake in the 12 MW Upper Kanchan Khola project, which is under construction in Dolakha. [1] The indicative price is Rs 64 crore. [1]

questions.question: What refinancing rate did the banks offer?
questions.answer: The CFO reported that two banks have offered to refinance the project loan at the base rate plus 1.5%, compared with plus 2% today. [1]

questions.question: What was the Q1 revenue?
questions.answer: Revenue from energy sales was Rs 26.0 crore, against a plan of Rs 28.2 crore. [1]

questions.question: sick leave kati din pauchha?
questions.answer: Employees get 12 days of paid sick leave a year. [1] Sick leave of more than 3 days in a row needs a doctor's certificate. [1] Unused sick leave can be accumulated up to 45 days. [1]

questions.question: penstock inspection kahile garne?
questions.answer: Check: Penstock inspection walk; How often: Every 3 months and after every earthquake above magnitude 5. [1]
